text:
hana (compliance): Auditor requested an auditable chain-of-custody and artifact manifest for the emergency RBAC change tied to the 2026-03-15 Prod incident. Need mapping to SOC2/ISO controls + signed manifest.

mike (oncall): tagging @rami @olivia. Which artifacts prove approval, execution, and KMS access? I can confirm the temporary RoleBinding existed ~2h.

rami (secops): Primary evidence sources: Jira ticket JIRA-4412 with approval comment, Vault (approval record + operator identity), GitOps PR showing the RoleBinding change, and CloudTrail entries for KMS Decrypt/Encrypt and IAM RoleBinding API calls. I will extract a timeline.

mike (oncall): the exact kubectl we ran for traceability:
```
kubectl create rolebinding emergency-incident-runner --clusterrole=view --serviceaccount=prod:incident-runner --namespace=prod
```

olivia (engops): I'll stage everything to s3://redwood-evidence/1743219999/incident-2026-03-15/ and sanitize per PII policy (redact IPs, session tokens). Will include pr-412-diff.patch from the infra repo.

auditor_jane: Need KMS-specific proof: DescribeKey snapshot at time-of-incident, key policy snapshot, key rotation state, and a filtered list of Decrypt calls showing principal, timestamp, and requestId. Also want assurance keys weren't exported to external accounts.

rami (secops): CloudTrail export shows Decrypt calls by `arn:aws:sts::123456789012:assumed-role/incident-runner-role/session` and an ops admin. Will export NDJSON with the relevant events and include DescribeKey and GetKeyRotationStatus outputs. Can also include KMS key policy JSON.

hana (compliance): For SOC2/ISO mapping, include a one-line mapping per artifact (e.g., `cloudtrail-kms-*.ndjson -> CC6.2 / A.10.1: crypto key usage logs`). Also include RBAC diffs (pre/post) from GitOps and the PR approval history. Include Slack reaction evidence if present.

mike (oncall): I confirmed I reacted :thumbsup: on the incident Slack thread at ts=1743220123 and left an "approved" comment on JIRA-4412.

olivia (engops): Git metadata: repo `infra/k8s-configs`, PR 412, commit abc1234. I'll export `git show` and the PR timeline as `pr-412-metadata.json` and `pr-412-diff.patch`.

evidence-bot: staging started  files being added: `jira-4412.pdf`, `pr-412-diff.patch`, `cloudtrail-kms-1743219999.ndjson`, `kms-describe-rlw-prod-logs.json`, `kms-rotation-1743219999.json`, `gitops-pr-412-metadata.json`. Current bundle size ~14MB.

auditor_jane: The manifest must include SHA256 checksums, storage path, who handled each artifact (names + timestamps), and redaction notes (fields removed + reason). Also require a signed chain-of-custody indicating personnel who accessed or packaged artifacts.

hana (compliance): I'll produce the manifest mapping artifacts to controls and include checksum+redaction notes. Will append a signed CoC PDF listing handlers: Rami (secops), Olivia (engops), Mike (oncall), Hana (compliance).

rami (secops): Uploaded sanitized CloudTrail and KMS extracts to the evidence path. I redacted source IPs and session tokens and noted that in the manifest.

olivia (engops): KMS snapshots captured via: `aws kms describe-key --key-id alias/rlw-prod-logs` and `aws kms get-key-rotation-status --key-id` outputs saved. Also captured IAM policy versioning for the KMS key.

auditor_jane: One last item: please include the process note describing how temporary RBAC changes are approved and revoked (link to runbook), and proof that the RoleBinding was removed after the incident window.

mike (oncall): I removed the RoleBinding at ts=1743220300. I'll attach `kubectl delete` output and the controller logs showing object deletion.

hana (compliance): Drafting manifest now. It'll include: artifact list, control mapping, SHA256 checksums, presigned S3 URLs (7d), redaction summary, handlers log, and CoC signature block. Target to post initial manifest in ~25m.

evidence-bot: package complete  presigned bundle URL (7d expiry): <redacted-presigned-url>  manifest saved as `coc-manifest-1743219999.json`.

auditor_jane: Received the presigned bundle and manifest. I'll review and post feedback within 48h. Thanks for the quick turnaround.

mike (oncall): great  once auditor confirms, we can close JIRA-4412 and mark incident follow-up done.

hana (compliance): noted. I'll update the control matrix and file the evidence package in our records.
